title: Home-Site Lease Collections Standard: Notice Timing and Repayment Agreement Limits
content:
For the Home-Site Lease, the collections limits are the same on every lot class. They set when a nonpayment notice is served and the bounds of a repayment agreement.

| Lot class | Nonpayment notice after this many days past the due day | Tenure for a repayment agreement | Most installments | Minimum down payment | Agreements per 12 months | Largest past-due balance covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 10 | 6 full months | 3 | 25.0 percent | 1 | 2.0 months of rent |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 10 | 6 full months | 3 | 25.0 percent | 1 | 2.0 months of rent |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 10 | 6 full months | 3 | 25.0 percent | 1 | 2.0 months of rent |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 10 | 6 full months | 3 | 25.0 percent | 1 | 2.0 months of rent |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 10 | 6 full months | 3 | 25.0 percent | 1 | 2.0 months of rent |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 10 | 6 full months | 3 | 25.0 percent | 1 | 2.0 months of rent |

**What each column means**

- *Nonpayment notice timing*: the calendar days after the due day after which a nonpayment notice is served when the rent for that period remains unpaid.
- *Tenure*: full months of tenancy since the move-in date required before a repayment agreement may be offered.
- *Most installments*: the maximum number of monthly installments in a repayment agreement.
- *Minimum down payment*: the share of the past-due balance that must be paid on the day a repayment agreement is signed.
- *Agreements per 12 months*: the most repayment agreements that may be signed in any trailing 12-month window.
- *Largest balance covered*: the largest past-due balance a repayment agreement may cover, as a multiple of the contracted monthly site rent.

*Hypothetical figure.* On a contracted monthly site rent of 650.00 the largest balance an agreement may cover is two months of rent, 1,300.00.
